stories.title: Arkansas lawmaker files bills to raise minimum age to purchase, use fireworks
stories.summary: After the death of a 14-year-old boy in a firework accident earlier this year, one lawmaker is filing legislation that he said will prevent further tragedies.

stories.title: Conway Regional expands maternal healthcare as labor units disappear across Arkansas
stories.summary: The hospital's labor and delivery unit is on track to deliver 2,000 babies this year as more expectant mothers travel farther for care.

stories.title: Mobile speech therapy on the go in central Arkansas as new nonprofit
stories.summary: Chatterbus on the Go has launched its new nonprofit to expand its reach across central Arkansas

stories.title: Faulkner County hunter finds human remains
stories.summary: Deputies opened an investigation after a hunter discovered human remains on Friday morning.

stories.title: Black Friday shoppers turn out early for deals at Bass Pro Shops
stories.summary: Shoppers flocked to Bass Pro Shops in Arkansas on Black Friday for deals, with many arriving the previous night.

stories.title: Annual 'Bob Robbins Memorial Toy Hill' ride brings joy and toys to local kids
stories.summary: Every December, dedicated motorcyclists ensure local children receive Christmas toys through the Bob Robbins Memorial Toy Hill event.

stories.title: Arkansas Food Bank driver delivers hope and groceries across the state
stories.summary: For one Arkansas Food Bank driver, the miles are measurable. The impact is not.

stories.title: Arkansas aesthetician faces complaints over alleged unfulfilled Botox services as state board continues investigation
stories.summary: An Arkansas aesthetician is facing multiple complaints from customers over alleged unfulfilled Botox services as the Board of Nursing continues their investigation.

stories.title: Little Rock man arrested in connection with residential fire
stories.summary: Pulaski County Sheriff's Office said the suspect was arrested and charged with two counts of arson.

stories.title: Three-car crash sends vehicle into rock quarry near Highway 367
stories.summary: A three-car crash near Cuthill Road and Highway 367 resulted in a water rescue when one vehicle went into a rock quarry.

stories.title: Jacksonville voters, candidates on runoff election for Mayor
stories.summary: In Jacksonville, voters will decide whether to keep Mayor Jeff Elmore or elect challenger James Bolden III in next Tuesday's runoff election.

stories.title: Arkansas AG Tim Griffin rejects $15 minimum wage proposal, calling initial title 'misleading'
stories.summary: AG Griffin has rejected a $15 minimum wage ballot proposal, stating that the initial title is "misleading" and doesn't accurately explain what the measure would do.
